shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rectangular block face
repeated circular disc or eye-like elements
rectilinear framed cells or cartouche-like compartments
justification: Both show shallow relief on a block face organised into horizontal registers of repeated, compartmentalised motifs combining round eye/disc elements, curling hooks and abstracted profile creature-heads, which is a fairly specific shared scheme of glyph-like or head-like signs in rows. The clearest difference is that A adds prominent sawtooth/zigzag bands and large arching crest forms over each head, while B's units are more strictly boxed into a grid of squarish cartouches without any zigzag banding.
